blurb: Micato Safaris offers luxury safaris in East and Southern Africa, featuring exclusive lodges and private game reserves. Guests experience guided game drives, bush walks, and cultural tours with expert guides. The company emphasizes impeccable service, safety, and comfort, with a 60-year history and numerous awards.
extraNote: Micato reserves the right to adjust or end your journey if a health concern arises · Guests should follow lodge staff directives regarding walking grounds after dark
